---
title: "About"
---

## Background

I was born and raised in Barranquilla, Colombia, and studied public accounting at
Universidad del Norte before moving to Vancouver. I later completed a diploma in
accounting at BCIT and spent six years working in the field here, mostly in
accounts receivable, corporate services, and month-end close.

## Why data science

Accounting gave me a lot of time with messy data and very little time with the
questions I actually wanted to ask of it. I kept building spreadsheets that were
really analyses in disguise, and eventually started learning SQL and Python on my
own to do the job properly. The MDS program is the deliberate version of that
detour: I want to move from reporting what happened to explaining why, and from
static reports to tools other people can use.

## Outside of data science

I play recreational soccer whenever I can find a game, and most of my weekends
involve some combination of football, cooking, and walking around Vancouver.
